name: discord-2
description: App de chat, voz e compartilhamento de tela no estilo Discord

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @discord-2/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @discord-2/shared" "npm run dev -w @discord-2/server" "npm run dev -w @discord-2/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @discord-2/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @discord-2/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
